en: Color photograph of a mid‑century modern office or civic building, elevated on piers above the ground floor and featuring long rows of windows and curtains. It stands at a street corner with zebra crossings and several small 1950s–60s European cars parked along the curb. In the background are steep, green mountains under a blue sky with scattered clouds. An older building with balconies appears on the left, and pedestrians walk along the sidewalks.
